item.title: geom_bar()
item.description:
SOS!!!
I am a beginner in R and I'm trying to teach myself starting with bar plots. I'm using some fishing data from a friend's research. So far I've learned to create data frames, and input data manually. I then learned to do the same thing but upload from an excel file. Now I am trying to manipulate raw data.
In excel I did the tallies myself for practice but now with the raw data I need the total count for each species tallied. I want to have each individual species listed once on the x-axis and their total on the y. I was able to do it by making the tallies in excel but i cant figure out how to make it tally the count for each individual species if that makes sense. this is my current code that isn't working.
please help!
ggplot(November\_raw\_practice, aes(x = reorder(Species, -Count), y = Count)) +
\# puts bars next to eachother, position = fill would make them stacked proportions, if it were blank it would show combined totals
geom\_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = 'steelblue') +
geom\_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
\# takes away gray default background
theme\_bw()+
theme(axis.text.x = element\_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
\# panel grid major/ minor leaves lines also
theme(panel.grid.major = element\_blank(),
panel.grid.minor = element\_blank())+
theme(plot.title = element\_text(hjust = 0.5))
labs(title = "Count of Species",
x = 'Species',
y = 'Count')
